item.text:
<linkedin_post>OpenAI says it made more than 200 referrals to law enforcement in the third quarter of 2026 involving imminent threats of violence. It plans to share more about how it identifies and responds to community safety risks in a report due in early 2027.

The first Community Safety Report will cover the second half of 2026. OpenAI says it will explain how its systems detect and investigate concerns, include anonymized examples and relevant data, and describe changes to its safeguards. The company plans to publish updates every six months.

That reporting could help people understand how often concerning activity leads to review or intervention and how well the safeguards work. The details OpenAI chooses to publish will matter, particularly as it develops tools that can end conversations or temporarily pause accounts when it detects repeated signs of a fixation on violence.</linkedin_post>
